content.text: No minimum-commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall, or volume-cap language exists anywhere in the agreement. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The agreement imposes no minimum purchase commitment, committed spend, take-or-pay obligation, shortfall penalty or volume cap on AP. Clause 1 expressly disclaims exclusivity and confirms AP remains free to monetize Inventory through other agents or third parties, and clause 5 (Fees and Payment) is a pure revenue-share on actual revenue generated through the Services/Auction Platform as detailed in each Exhibit — i.e., compensation follows usage only, with no floor. Searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall" and "volume" return only the Winning Bid Price floor set by AP itself (p0014, which benefits us) and Kubient's disclaimer that no minimum revenue level is guaranteed (p0062) — neither is a commitment binding AP. No Exhibit in the document contains committed volumes or spend. This meets the preferred position (no minimum commitment; fees for usage/ordered services only), so no redline is warranted. Note for diligence: any future Exhibit could introduce committed volumes, so Exhibits should be reviewed as executed; also, under clause 4(a) AP cannot terminate during the one-year Initial Term and Kubient is entitled to fees generated during the termination period, but that is a term/termination point rather than a purchase commitment and is addressed under the termination rule.
